app.title: BunkerWeb Whitelist
skin.label: Skin
hero.not_listed: This address is not on the whitelist yet. Add it and BunkerWeb lets you through.
hero.listed: This address is on the whitelist until {until}.
hero.listed_forever: This address is on the whitelist and never expires.
hero.no_ip: Your address could not be determined. Check TRUSTED_PROXIES.
login.footer: The password lives in the container environment as WHITELISTER_PASSWORD.
add.label: Label
add.hint_days: Expires on {until}. You can extend it any time in the list below.
add.hint_date: Expires at the end of the chosen day.
add.hint_forever: The entry stays until you remove it. Meant for office addresses, not for hotel Wi-Fi.
add.api_note: BunkerWeb fetches the list and reloads
list.empty: No entries yet. Your address above is a good first one.
extend.new_end: New end: {date} · counted from the current end, not from today.
flash.added_forever: {network} is allowed with no end date.
flash.sync_failed: Saved here, but BunkerWeb could not be told to refresh: {error}. It retries in the background.
error.ip_invalid: That is not a valid IP address or network.
error.ip_private: Private addresses are not allowed here.
error.label_too_long: The label is limited to {max} characters.
error.date_invalid: That is not a valid date.
error.date_in_past: The end date must be in the future.
error.duration_missing: Pick how long the entry should be valid.
error.csrf: The form has expired. Please try again.
footer.text: Global whitelist · BunkerWeb fetches {url} · expired entries are removed by the container itself. 🌇
footer.text_no_api: Global whitelist · BunkerWeb API not configured, the list is only served at {url}. 🌇
offline.title: You are offline
offline.text: The whitelist lives on the server, so there is nothing to show or change without a connection.
hero.unconfirmed: … waiting for BunkerWeb to pick the list up
add.prefilled: Pre-filled from the link you opened. Check it and confirm.
list.fetched: BunkerWeb last fetched the list at {date}
list.not_fetched: BunkerWeb has not fetched the list yet
list.confirmed: On BunkerWeb's list since its last fetch
list.unconfirmed: Changed after BunkerWeb's last fetch; waiting for the next one
backup.text: Export saves every entry as a JSON file. Import adds the entries from such a file; existing networks get the file's label and end date, entries that are already over are skipped.
backup.import_confirm: Import the entries from this file into the whitelist?
import.too_large: That file is too large to import (256 KB at most).
import.invalid: That file is not a whitelist export.
import.done: {count} entries imported, {skipped} already over and skipped.
invite.admin_text: A link you can send to someone without asking for their address. Whoever opens it puts their own address on the list for the access period. Each new address counts against the link's budget; opening it again from a known address only refreshes that address.
invite.name: Name
invite.create_note: The link is shown once; only its fingerprint is kept.
invite.created: Link for {name} created. Copy it now, it will not be shown again.
invite.share_hint: Send this link to the person. Anyone who has it can put their address on the list until it expires.
invite.revoke_confirm: Revoke the link for {name}? Addresses already on the list stay until they expire.
invite.name_missing: Give the link a name, for example the person it is for.
error.too_many_invites: Too many open links ({max}). Revoke some first.
invite.closed_title: This link is no longer valid
invite.closed_text: The link has expired, was revoked or never existed. Please ask for a new one.
invite.no_address: Your address could not be determined, so nothing can be unlocked from here.
invite.exhausted: This link has used up its addresses. Please ask for a new one.
invite.ready: Press the button and this connection is unlocked for {days}.
invite.known: This connection is already unlocked until {until}. Press the button to start the period again.
invite.done: Done. Your access from this connection is valid until {until}.
invite.done_note: It takes a moment for the change to reach the gateway. If you change networks, open the link again from there.
invite.remaining.one: This link can unlock {count} more address
invite.remaining.other: This link can unlock {count} more addresses
invite.remaining_unlimited: This link can unlock further addresses
invite.footer: Nothing to install, no password: the button records the address you are connecting from.
invite.og_description: One click unlocks this connection. No password, nothing to install.
